**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

The agreement contains no audit, inspection, verification or records-examination right in Kubient's favour — searches for "audit", "inspect" and "records" returned no hits, and a full read of the document (one continuous section) confirms it. The only access obligation on AP is Section 1's cooperation language, which exists so Kubient can deliver the Services, not to verify our usage. Since no vendor-side audit right binds us, there are no frequency, notice, cost or system-access terms to constrain, and the position is more favourable than the playbook's preferred stance.

One non-blocking observation for the commercial team: AP likewise has no express right to audit Kubient's Impression measurement or revenue-share reporting, even though Impressions are "measured by Kubient." That is a reporting/revenue-assurance point outside this rule's scope, but it may be worth raising separately if verification of the revenue share matters.
